final_novel_output_parity.interpretation: All four complete final streams are byte-identical to the original recorded default/spacing streams. Existing novel judgments and all compact individual spacing observations transfer exactly; memoization changes no exported candidate or span.

search_stress.method: Repeated ambiguous case phrase, followed by either dictionary-missing ZZZ or an independently analyzed lexical predicate. Failed suffixes are memoized only after complete exhaustion; successful prefixes remain distinct. A 123-character stress test explicitly raises limits, preserving sixteen alternatives for the successful tail. This engineering input is not a grammatical/annotated source sentence.
search_stress.interpretation: Eight descriptive release probes retain identical completeness, probe counts and output counts. The high-limit repeated 지식인들을 case drops from about 1.715s to 0.054s in these single measurements. Timing is not a portable regression threshold.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.

ledger_counts.interpretation: Independent words are not flattened into a single original-word analysis. The existing raw/policy ledger is unchanged; the spacing ledger has stable separate component judgments.
